name: rules
description: Small game rules as data: watch a number and raise an action when it enters a range (a score that reaches a goal, a life that falls to 0, a timer that runs out), and change a number when an action is raised (choose what a button places, set a speed, empty a score). Numbers are fields ("module.Component.field") of the entity the rule watches or changes, which is itself or the one carrying a tag. No rule here is about a particular game.

components.name: Watch
components.description: Raises the action each time the number field of the watched entity comes into the range min to max (both ends included) from outside it: min 2048 and the default max make "reaches 2048", max 0 and the default min make "falls to 0 or less", min and max equal make "becomes exactly". The watched entity is this one with own, otherwise the oldest entity with the tag source. With once it raises the action a single time in the game, otherwise again each time the number goes out of the range and back in. A number that is already inside when the game starts counts as coming in. inside and fired are its own state. A Disabled entity is not watched. A missing component leaves the number at 0.

components.name: OnAction
components.description: When the action is pressed, sets the number field of the target to value, or with add adds value to it. The target is this entity with own, otherwise the oldest entity with the tag source. Choose what a shop button places (the Placer's prefab), double the speed, empty a score, count something up. Raise the action from a button, a key, a Watch or another module. With link (a field holding an entity link, such as grid2d.Zone.entered), the target is instead the entity that this entity (or the tagged one) points to with that field: the piece a zone has just seen, the enemy a tower aims at. A missing target or component is ignored.

components.name: Press
components.description: When start is pressed, the game holds action at value for ticks ticks, delay ticks later, as a player would: a demonstration (the character walks or jumps by itself to show how), an attract mode, a cut scene. Several Presses on the same start make a sequence. times counts the presses made. A Disabled entity does not press.

systems.name: watch
systems.description: Checks every Watch against its number and raises the action of the ones that just came into their range.

systems.name: on_action
systems.description: Applies every OnAction whose action is pressed this tick.

systems.name: press
systems.description: Starts every Press whose start is pressed this tick: its action is held from the next tick on (after its delay), then let go.
